title: CRADLE BENCH: A Clinician-Annotated Benchmark for Multi-Faceted Mental Health Crisis and Safety Risk Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the clinical detection of mental health crises and safety risks (such as suicide ideation, abuse, and domestic violence) based on medical and psychological standards. While it includes an 'Ethical Statements' section, its primary objective is clinical safety classification rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of religious, spiritual, moral, or ethical frameworks.
